args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of silently returning stale value
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently swallowing exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This caused dashboards to show stale data during outages with no visible error trace.

## Fix
Changed the `except Exception` block to re-raise the exception instead of returning the stale `_last` value. This ensures failures are immediately visible to callers.

## Change
**`src/cache.py`**
```python
# Before
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently

# After
except Exception:
    raise
```

## Tests
- `test_compute_failure_contract` — now passes: `ValueError` is propagated correctly
- `test_returns_computed_value` — continues to pass: normal compute path unaffected
